name: Carlisle's Confession
source:
On the night of his 10th anniversary, Carlisle has a talk with his wife when he receives an alarming text message. He must now confront with the secrets he hides over a tense and claustrophobic  late night conversation.

[From [url=https://grey-journal-studios.itch.io/carlisles-confession]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在结婚十周年纪念日的那天晚上，卡莱尔正在与妻子交谈时，收到了一条令人震惊的短信。他现在必须面对他在一场紧张而幽闭的深夜谈话中隐藏的秘密。

[来自[url=https://grey-journal-studios.itch.io/carlisles-confession]itch.io[/url]]
